_about: Guide version registry. One entry per release that changed fees, service structure, or the Terms of Service / consent form. Wording and layout changes are not releases: they are built into the current version in place. `version` names the folder guide/<version>/, `effective` is the same date in ISO form, `services` lists the pages whose quoted content changed in that release, `tos` is the date of the Terms of Service in force. The build refuses a release that changes a page it does not list. See guide/HANDOVER.md.

versions.note: First versioned release: the five guides as sent to the first families.
